SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS totalAmount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(o.amount), 2), 0) AS avgAmount, IFNULL(MAX(o.amount), 0) AS maxAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT i.category_id) AS categoryCount
, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(o.created_at, i.created_at)), 1) AS avgDaysToSell
FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_item i ON i.id = o.item_id WHERE

SELECT i.category_id AS categoryId, IFNULL(c.name, '其他') AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_item i ON i.id = o.item_id LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = i.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE GROUP BY i.category_id, c.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_item i ON i.id = o.item_id WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
